maria_support: Customer (finaxis) reporting a sudden spike in 429s this morning, started ~2026-03-17T15:05:22Z. They see ~1.1k rpm and ~30 tpm on their client side. They say responses are intermittent and many clients retry quickly.
veena_sre: grabbing logs from edge. Do we have request IDs they can share? ask them for a couple of failing request IDs and whether they received Retry-After headers.
maria_support: sent two example request IDs: req_9a3f2 and req_9a3f8. They pasted a snippet from their client showing 429 with no Retry-After header (they're using our hosted API). They also say they stream multiple concurrent connections per user.
rate-limit-bot: alert: /v1/generate route returned 429 spikes in us-west-2 between 15:04-15:06 UTC (rate-limit: per-route RPM reached).
veena_sre: Looking at edge traces: our gateway returned 429 with x-ratelimit-rpm-limit: 1000, x-ratelimit-rpm-remaining: 0 for several windows. Seems they hit per-route RPM cap, not TPM.
sam_runtime: Could also be token bucket refills aligning with their cron; do we see minute-boundary alignment? check if their traffic has a lot of short bursts.
jitender_eng: From the customer's logs it looks like they open 6 parallel streamed connections per user and reconnect on failure immediately (no jitter/backoff). That can amplify RPM. Suggest they add exponential backoff with full jitter and cap concurrency.
maria_support: Customer asks if we can temporarily increase their RPM while they implement fixes. They're on standard account.
veena_sre: Short term we can consider a temporary quota escalation if they sign an SLA addendum. I'll start approval flow but want mitigation steps first.
sam_runtime: For immediate mitigation, ask the customer to obey Retry-After header (if missing maybe their client stripped it) and to implement client-side token bucket smoothing: e.g. keep a local counter and spread requests evenly across the minute.
jitender_eng: Also recommend enabling streaming multiplexing correctly (single connection + multiple streams where possible) instead of many full HTTP connections per user.
maria_support: Pasted a small suggested code snippet for jittered backoff: ```python
import random, time
def backoff(attempt):
    sleep = min(60, (2 ** attempt) + random.random())
    time.sleep(sleep)
```
veena_sre: Ask customer to also send a sampling of request timestamps (UTC) across the minute to confirm boundary bunching. If we see >1000 requests in the top second it's a clear minute-boundary bump.
maria_support: Customer provided timestamp sample — confirmed lots of requests within a 3s window at minute boundaries.
sam_runtime: That explains hitting RPM limit. TPM not reached because their long streams keep token count low, but RPM spikes kill them.
jitender_eng: Long-term: recommend rate-limiting middleware on their side and staggered cron/jitter for batch producers. We can share our SDK's retry helper.
veena_sre: Proceeding with temporary +15% RPM increase while they roll out fixes, pending approvals. Also adding a short-lived canary rule to avoid impacting other customers.
maria_support: Customer happy with temporary bump and will roll out backoff + connection changes today. Follow-up: I'll schedule a 1:1 to review telemetry after 24h. :thumbsup:
rate-limit-bot: note: action taken: temporary rate increase (+15%) applied to tenant finaxis until 2026-03-18T16:00:00Z per SRE approval.
